metadata.source: sf sobject describe; union of four prepared Enterprise-shape orgs
metadata.object_selection: 48 documented Contracts CLM, state-model, and Context Service objects
notes: Schema metadata only; no customer records, clause bodies, or document content queried.
ContractType is absent from rlm-base__ent_1001; DocumentTemplate is absent from rlm-base__ent_1002_main. Each is included from the other three same-release orgs as feature-gated.

Four additional 264 Contracts Developer Guide API pages (ContractExtractionResult, DocumentPlaybook, DocumentPlaybookAssignment, DocumentPlaybookVersion) were absent from describeGlobal in the primary org; direct describe returned resource-not-found for each name in all four prepared orgs.

DocumentEnvelope.ReferenceObjectId is polymorphic and had different target sets across prepared orgs; this snapshot stores the union of observed targets. Picklist values are unioned across orgs and can vary with org configuration.
DocGenBtchStsChgEvent and DocGenProcStsChgEvent are included as documented status-event objects; describe marks both non-SOQL-queryable in all four orgs.
